name: Itsu made mo Ore wa Mama ni Koishiteru! ~Ii yo, Mama ni Amaete, Oppai de Ippai Osewa Shite Ageru♪~
original_name: いつまでも俺は母に恋してる！～いいよ、ママに甘えて、おっぱいでいっぱいお世話してあげる♪～
source:
The protagonist is just a normal student, except for the fact that his home is a café managed by his mother. His father is currently oversea in search of legendary coffee beans.

Furthermore, often comes to the café are his best friend's mother, his aunt and a next-door housewife whom he has known for a long time. And before he knows it, all around him are full of older women.

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc052/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主角只是一个普通的学生，只不过他的家是他母亲经营的一家咖啡馆。他的父亲目前正在海外寻找传奇咖啡豆。

而且，经常来咖啡馆的还有他最好朋友的母亲、他的阿姨和他认识已久的隔壁家庭主妇。不知不觉间，他的周围就站满了年长的女人。

[翻译自[url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc052/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
